title: Chunk Claiming
description: As a true apex predator of this blocky world, you have to <positive>mark your territory</positive> to assure your dominance over this particular domain (and protect it from others just as apex and just as predators as yourself), and that's where this handy new <keyword>flag</keyword> comes into play!

<positive>Place it</positive> on unclaimed soil to <positive>claim it</positive> for your team (or yourself if that's what you fancy). Works similar to the claim chunk FTB function, just without the actual map involved (since you haven't unlocked one yet).
§lYou can press <keyword>F3 + G</keyword> to enable <property>chunk highlighting</property>.§r
